primitive: ASM Agent Stack Fabric architecture
invariant: One Go authority retains reviewed mutation and runtime ownership
negative_invariant: No donor runtime or file synchronizer becomes a second authority

primitive: versioned canonical artifact envelope
invariant: Canonical IDs content references provenance security classes and extension data are digest-bound
negative_invariant: Unknown target data cannot be silently discarded

primitive: deterministic unknown-extension preservation
invariant: Equivalent JSON produces stable bytes without numeric precision loss
negative_invariant: Duplicate keys and trailing JSON cannot enter canonical extension state

primitive: compatibility-preserving Resource Hub canonical envelope
invariant: Current Resource Hub payloads and digests remain authoritative and are represented without mutation
negative_invariant: The graph view cannot rewrite the registry target files plans backups or managed state

primitive: operator-visible canonical graph inspection
invariant: Canonical graph inspection is read-only and machine-verifiable
negative_invariant: Graph inspection cannot authorize or apply a mutation

primitive: immutable content-addressed blob and tree store
invariant: Blob and tree identities are deterministic digest-bound and recursively verifiable
negative_invariant: No symlink traversal special file corruption or unverified existing object is accepted

primitive: garbage-collection reachability marks
invariant: Reachable object closure is deterministic and complete
negative_invariant: This phase never deletes CAS objects

primitive: reversible Resource Hub shadow migration stage
invariant: Every staged resource round-trips to its legacy digest and the receipt binds source and staged graph identities
negative_invariant: Staging cannot transfer authority or accept stale source state

primitive: operator-visible CAS stage verify and restore workflow
invariant: Receipts are strict bounded inputs and restore targets are new verified paths
negative_invariant: Restore cannot overwrite or run without explicit confirmation

primitive: typed canonical JSON serialization
invariant: Typed metadata rows use the same deterministic JSON admission as extension payloads
negative_invariant: Database persistence cannot bypass duplicate-key and trailing-value rules

primitive: versioned transactional SQLite shadow metadata
invariant: Sealed receipt history and canonical artifact and resource rows are transactionally stored and reverified
negative_invariant: SQLite cannot become Resource Hub authority or adopt an unrelated database

primitive: verified SQLite online backup
invariant: Backup bytes are created through SQLite then inspected before no-replace publication
negative_invariant: Backup cannot overwrite an existing destination or publish unverified state

primitive: operator-visible SQLite stage inspect verify and backup workflow
invariant: Stage is lease-bound while inspect and verify remain read-only and machine-readable
negative_invariant: CLI cannot promote SQLite authority or backup without explicit confirmation

primitive: versioned non-authoritative target adapter contract
invariant: Adapters deterministically normalize render plan and verify without performing I/O or granting authority
negative_invariant: No adapter may write target state execute a client command approve a plan or bypass core ownership and rollback

primitive: structural digest-bound target capability negotiation
invariant: Target aliases artifact support fields deployment modes and MCP registration semantics are explicit versioned and sealed
negative_invariant: Aliases cannot collide and unsupported behavior cannot be implied by an informal boolean

primitive: machine-readable target fidelity and loss report
invariant: Transformation fallback omission and unsupported semantics are field-addressed sorted and digest-bound with derived fidelity
negative_invariant: Representational loss cannot be hidden overridden by caller-supplied fidelity or altered after review

primitive: reviewed in-process Codex Claude Cursor AGY OpenCode Copilot and generic adapters
invariant: Existing target paths and registration modes are expressed through one target-native contract with confined projections
negative_invariant: No donor runtime target writer package installer or unrestricted plugin loader is introduced

primitive: Resource Hub adapter-bound reviewed sync planning with deny-loss
invariant: Every sync plan and operation binds current capability and fidelity evidence before existing Resource Hub mutation
negative_invariant: Capability drift altered operation losses foreign state or deny-loss violations cannot reach apply

primitive: MCP client adapter-bound reviewed registration planning
invariant: Every selected client operation binds a sealed structural capability and fidelity report while mcplink retains mutation and rollback
negative_invariant: An adapter cannot mutate client state and apply cannot accept snapshot drift tampered loss evidence or a foreign registration

primitive: operator-visible capability inspection and loss policy
invariant: Operators can inspect verified target capabilities and require loss-free Resource Hub plans without mutation
negative_invariant: Inspection and deny-loss policy cannot authorize apply or bypass exact plan confirmation

primitive: embedded target adapter conformance oracle and sealed differential report
invariant: Every reviewed built-in adapter alias MCP capability and declared artifact projection resolves to explicit deterministic evidence
negative_invariant: A passing score cannot load external code grant authority hide loss accept path ambiguity or claim arbitrary target parsing

primitive: operator-visible read-only adapter conformance execution
invariant: Operators and CI receive the complete sealed report and aliases deduplicate to canonical targets
negative_invariant: The conformance command cannot inspect live target state mutate files approve plans or suppress failed cases

primitive: versioned one-request external adapter process protocol
invariant: Every external operation negotiates exact protocol contract target request identity deadline and required operation before producing sealed adapter evidence
negative_invariant: The protocol cannot register activate authorize or mutate through an external adapter and malformed or drifting identities fail closed

primitive: digest-pinned bounded external executable admission and invocation
invariant: Exact regular-file bytes and arguments are staged into a private session; every fresh process is deadline/output bounded and can request fail-closed OS process ceilings through the shared managed-process controller
negative_invariant: Symlinks digest mismatch source races inherited secrets shell execution unbounded output successful stderr unsupported hard-limit claims and uncontained bounded children cannot enter accepted evidence

primitive: reviewed capability ceiling and machine-readable intersection receipt
invariant: The effective external capability is never stronger than the reviewed built-in target and all restrictions or candidate limitations are sealed
negative_invariant: External-only claims structural destination changes MCP registration changes or within-session capability drift cannot gain authority

primitive: reference-versus-external Phase 5 corpus differential report
invariant: Reference and candidate execute the same embedded corpus and every case status and evidence digest is compared inside a sealed derived report
negative_invariant: A score cannot hide case omission path escape plan divergence postcondition divergence capability restriction or report tampering

primitive: operator-visible pinned external adapter differential conformance
invariant: The CLI uses synthetic paths prints the complete sealed report and returns nonzero when candidate evidence fails
negative_invariant: The command cannot expose real target state register an executable or turn a passing report into deployment approval
